note: Place identity and public location evidence; not a building facade survey or verified entrance inventory.

entries.name: Mansoura Specialized Hospital / Old General
entries.locationEvidence: Google business pin and address explicitly identify the specialized hospital; official hospital social account linked by the listing. The government budget retains the Old General name. Both names represent this one destination, not two invented sites.

entries.name: Mansoura New General / International Hospital
entries.locationEvidence: Mapped hospital compound center; the government budget explicitly equates New General with International Hospital. Road stop is projected, not a surveyed gate.

entries.name: Mansoura University Specialized Medical Hospital
entries.locationEvidence: Separate university hospital, matched business pin and official El Gomhouria address. It must not be conflated with the old general hospital.

entries.name: Mansoura University Emergency Hospital
entries.locationEvidence: Center of the named mapped hospital footprint; university directory confirms Gehan Street. This point is not asserted to be its exact entrance.

entries.name: Geziret El Ward Sporting Club
entries.locationEvidence: Named mapped club compound, corroborated by the official address list placing its second gate on Lower Al Mashaya. Compound center is distinct from the projected public street stop.

entries.name: El Hewar Sporting Club
entries.locationEvidence: Named OSM club with Lower Al Mashaya address; official ITIDA address list independently locates the club opposite its branch.

entries.name: Touril Street / district
entries.locationEvidence: Named mapped Touril Street, independently present in the official polling-address list. This is a public street destination in the district, not a fabricated landmark building.

entries.name: Dakahlia Governorate — Citizen Services
entries.locationEvidence: Public listing explicitly identifies the citizen-service centre within the governorate headquarters at this pin. Official electricity report and chamber directory place the headquarters on El Gomhouria. The separate Dakahlia Governrate business pin on Saber Nakhala conflicts and was rejected. This is a campus service point, not a surveyed main-building centroid or entrance.

entries.name: Mansoura Court Complex — El Geish
entries.locationEvidence: Named Mansoura Elementary Court public pin; official election committee list places it on El Geish opposite the sporting stadium. Distinct from the old court complex on El Gomhouria and the relocated Council of State courts. Pin is not a surveyed public gate.

entries.name: El-Mansoura Sporting Stadium
entries.locationEvidence: Representative point within the named mapped sporting compound on El Geish, opposite the court complex. This retains the existing stadium destination ID rather than adding a duplicate. It is distinct from the university sports complex; architectural details are not reconstructed.
